blocks.arabic_text: رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ انْصَرَفَ إِلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالَ: لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا لَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللهِ لَأَحْبَبْتُمْ أَنْ تَزْدَادُوا فَاقَةً وَحَاجَةً قَالَ فَضَالَةُ: وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح ، باب ما جاء في معيشة اصحاب النبي ﷺ، رقم:٢٣٦٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Fadalah ibn Ubaid (RA) narrates, “When Rasulullah ﷺ led the Salah, some of the Companions of the Suffah who were in the row would fall down because of hunger. The villagers, seeing them, would think, “These people are mad.” One day, after Rasulullah ﷺ had led the Salah, he turned towards them and said, “If you knew the reward that is with Allah for you, you would love to be in even more poverty and want than this.” Hazrat Fadalah ibn Ubaid (RA) said, “On that day I was with the Prophet ﷺ.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ صَلَّي الْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَامَ نِصْفَ اللَّيْلِ، وَمَنْ صَلَّي الصُّبْحَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا صَلَّي اللَّيْلَ كُلَّهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل صلاة العشاء والصبح في جماعة رقم:١٤٩١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever prays the 'Isha Salah with the congregation is like one who worshipped for half the night. Whoever prays the Fajr Salah with the congregation is like one who worshipped the whole night.”

blocks.text: Note:- That one who prays both the 'Isha Salah and the Fajr Salah in congregation receives the reward of worshipping the whole night has been, citing other narrations, by some 'ulama
